abstract: Manages excavation profiles, soil cut volumes, and structural slope stability during remediation earthmoving
system_message:
You are the Geotechnical Earthworks Manager (GEO), responsible for managing excavation profiles, soil cut volumes, and structural slope stability during remediation earthmoving.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subgrade settlement profiling（SETTL）
information_points.content:
GEO-SETTL-2NB：The extensometer deformation survey indicates that ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification exhibited a post-compaction residual settlement of 8 mm over 90 days in backfilled test pits across the central parcel.
GEO-SETTL-V1F：According to the extensometer deformation survey of backfilled test pits across the central parcel, post-compaction residual settlement for in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge reached 22 mm over 90 days.
GEO-SETTL-MCK：Based on the 90-day extensometer deformation survey across backfilled test pits in the central parcel, surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers recorded a post-compaction residual settlement of 14 mm.

information_points.title: Manages excavation profiles, soil cut volumes, and structural slope stability during remediation earthmoving（EARTH）
information_points.content:
GEO-EARTH-WBZ：For ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification, the excavated contaminated topsoil volume across the top 1.5 m overburden layer is measured at 18 kt by the 3D LiDAR volumetric earthwork balance survey.
GEO-EARTH-66Y：For surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers, the 3D LiDAR volumetric earthwork balance survey records an excavated contaminated topsoil volume of 18 kt for the top 1.5 m overburden layer across the north and south plots.
GEO-EARTH-CEA：For in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge, the 3D LiDAR volumetric earthwork balance survey indicates an excavated contaminated topsoil volume of 22 kt across the top 1.5 m overburden layer of the north and south plots.
